description_en: Queries the current clustering configuration, recommended configuration, and estimated shuffle benefits for a specified table. If a recommendation is available, the corresponding ALTER TABLE SQL statement is also returned
description_zh: 查询指定表的当前聚簇配置、推荐配置和预估 Shuffle 收益。有建议时可查看对应的表变更 SQL
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute get-auto-cluster-suggestion --project analytics_prod --table order_detail --api-version 2022-01-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAutoClusterSuggestion

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute table
parameters.name: table

parameters.help_en: The date of the analysis batch in the yyyyMMdd format. If this parameter is not specified, the latest batch of the corresponding dataset is used
parameters.help_zh: 分析批次日期，格式为 yyyyMMdd。不传时使用对应数据集的最新批次
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
parameters.help_zh: 表所属的 Schema 名称
parameters.name: schema

data.description_en: The automatic clustering recommendations for the table
data.description_zh: 查询表的自动聚簇建议的结果

alterTableSql.description_en: The ALTER TABLE SQL statement used to apply the recommendation
alterTableSql.description_zh: 应用建议时使用的表变更 SQL
alterTableSql.example: ALTER TABLE order_detail CLUSTERED BY (customer_id) SORTED BY (customer_id) INTO 32 BUCKETS;

applied.description_en: Specifies whether the current table configuration is consistent with the recommendation. The clustering type, number of buckets, cluster keys, and sort keys are compared
applied.description_zh: 当前表配置是否与建议一致。比较聚簇类型、桶数、聚簇键和排序键

benefitJobCount.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is no longer returned. Do not rely on it. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
benefitJobCount.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

bucketNum.description_en: The number of buckets in the cluster

clusterKey.description_en: The list of cluster key column names

items.description_en: The name of a cluster key column

clusterType.description_en: The clustering type. For example, hash indicates hash clustering
clusterType.description_zh: 聚簇类型。例如 hash 表示哈希聚簇

increasedWriteCu.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is no longer returned. Do not rely on it. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
increasedWriteCu.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

increasedWriteShuffle.description_en: The estimated amount of write shuffle data increased after the recommendation is applied, in GB
increasedWriteShuffle.description_zh: 应用建议后预估增加的写入 Shuffle 数据量，单位为 GB

partition.description_en: The names of the partition columns of the table. Multiple column names are separated by commas
partition.description_zh: 表的分区列名称。多个列名以逗号分隔

partitionScanList.description_en: The list of table partitions involved in the recommendation analysis
partitionScanList.description_zh: 参与建议分析的表分区列表

items.description_en: The identifier of a table partition involved in the analysis
items.description_zh: 参与分析的表分区标识

project.description_en: The name of the MaxCompute project

readInstanceList.description_en: The list of read job instance IDs associated with the evaluation of this recommendation
readInstanceList.description_zh: 评估该建议时关联的读取作业实例 ID 列表

items.description_en: The ID of a read job instance

savedCu.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is no longer returned. Do not rely on it. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
savedCu.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

savedReadCu.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is no longer returned. Do not rely on it. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
savedReadCu.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

savedReadShuffle.description_en: The estimated amount of read shuffle data saved after the recommendation is applied, in GB
savedReadShuffle.description_zh: 应用建议后预估可节省的读取 Shuffle 数据量，单位为 GB

savedShuffle.description_en: The estimated net amount of shuffle data saved, in GB. This value is calculated by subtracting the increased write shuffle data from the saved read shuffle data
savedShuffle.description_zh: 预估净节省的 Shuffle 数据量，单位为 GB。按读取侧节省量减去写入侧增加量计算

savedTime.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is no longer returned. Do not rely on it. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
savedTime.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

schema.description_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
schema.description_zh: 表所属的 Schema 名称

sortKey.description_en: The list of sort key column names within the cluster
sortKey.description_zh: 聚簇内的排序列名列表

items.description_en: The name of a sort key column

suggestBucketNum.description_en: The recommended number of buckets in the cluster
suggestBucketNum.description_zh: 建议使用的聚簇分桶数量

suggestClusterKey.description_en: The list of recommended cluster key column names
suggestClusterKey.description_zh: 建议使用的聚簇键列名列表

items.description_en: The name of a column recommended as a cluster key
items.description_zh: 建议用作聚簇键的列名

suggestClusterType.description_en: The recommended clustering type. hash indicates hash clustering
suggestClusterType.description_zh: 建议使用的聚簇类型。hash 表示哈希聚簇

suggestSortKey.description_en: The list of recommended sort key column names within the cluster
suggestSortKey.description_zh: 建议使用的聚簇内排序列名列表

items.description_en: The name of a column recommended as a sort key within the cluster
items.description_zh: 建议用作聚簇内排序键的列名

table.description_en: The name of the MaxCompute table

writeInstanceList.description_en: The list of write job instance IDs associated with the evaluation of this recommendation
writeInstanceList.description_zh: 评估该建议时关联的写入作业实例 ID 列表

items.description_en: The ID of a write job instance

errorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
errorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

errorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
errorMsg.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

httpCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
httpCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the API request. Provide this identifier when troubleshooting API call issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的唯一标识。排查调用问题时可提供该标识
